supersession_20260810.reason: both composite and four-axis dual-reviewer semantic suitability failed repeatability and bidirectional-support gates while the private paired-outcome key remained closed
supersession_20260810.retired: pre_effect_semantic_gate.gold_source and every reviewer should-open projection as PM gold
supersession_20260810.preserved: public-anchor outcome-blind state contrasts, low-capacity heads, Q/R/F/C separation, 16-action joint panel, baselines, and three external tasks

why_new_version_is_required.v5_3_formal_result: 0 of 4 frozen heads passed on 576 complete effect groups

research_scope_unchanged.only_new_generated_training_outcomes: paired whole-response effects on outcome-blind public-backbone state variants

v5_3_failure_diagnosis.conclusion: The panel mainly taught that a valid actual-Rank1 resource is often useful; it did not supply balanced, runtime-observable semantic conditions that explain when marginal value changes. More users or a larger regressor alone do not repair this.

separation_of_responsibility.semantic_observation_layer: Must identify a small predeclared set of runtime-observable opportunity and boundary conditions without effect outcomes.
separation_of_responsibility.retrieval_layer: Must freeze the actual Rank-1 candidate and report no-candidate, wrong-candidate, and margin failures separately.
separation_of_responsibility.step2_generator_layer: Must receive and functionally use authorized evidence; requested, received, used, functional, fallback, and overload remain separate.
separation_of_responsibility.effect_measurement_layer: Must demonstrate reproducible high-versus-low opportunity uplift separation before a PM model is blamed.
separation_of_responsibility.pm_layer: Is responsible only after semantic observations pass, candidate identity is valid, Step2 functions, labels are repeatable, and the frozen head still fails grouped OOF.
separation_of_responsibility.joint_policy_layer: Is assessed only on same-state all-16-action panels after component heads qualify.

state_family_design.unit: one public-source anchor plus one frozen valid candidate and 2-4 outcome-blind current-state variants
required_within_family_contrasts: same broad topic with different current response function
state_family_design.candidate_rule: Candidate must remain owner/time/version valid. Wrong-owner, future, superseded, or absent candidates are retrieval/hard-gate tests and never positive/negative PM labels.
state_family_design.variant_text_rule: Variants may be newly written but must remain faithful to the public-source world state; they may not contain labels, component names, construction tags, or imperative phrases that reveal the expected action.
state_family_design.split_rule: All variants from one anchor/candidate/counterfactual family stay in one fold; broad capabilities and implicit/explicit paraphrases occur in every fold.
state_family_design.nuisance_balance: length, punctuation, explicitness, author/template family, topic, candidate age, session depth, and subtype must not predict the intended condition on their own

pre_effect_semantic_gate.gold_source: blind dual annotation of semantic conditions using only runtime-visible state and frozen candidate; disagreements are adjudicated without effect outcomes
pre_effect_semantic_gate.minimum_panel: at least 48 state variants per component and at least 12 counterfactual families before any effect pilot
pre_effect_semantic_gate.failure_owner: semantic observation/data construction layer; no paired-effect API budget is spent

development_effect_feasibility_gate.panel: 16 counterfactual families per component, two primary variants per family, three paired generator seeds per state; 128 effect groups total
development_effect_feasibility_gate.failure_owner: state contrast, resource utility, Step2 generator, or effect measurement; revise only in a subsequently named development revision before freezing confirmation

head_design.target: continuous positive-support-contribution uplift; risk and cost do not enter the target
head_design.primary_features: pre-effect validated semantic condition probabilities plus a frozen low-dimensional BGE surface and deterministic candidate/runtime descriptors
head_design.model_family: regularized linear or monotone/additive low-capacity model selected once on V5.3 plus the V5.4 development pilot
head_design.MP_posthoc_hint_not_confirmation: state-BGE PCA 3-5 without weak appended scalars reached V5.3 posthoc relative MSE about 0.94 and Spearman about 0.236
forbidden: construction condition as the worth-opening label
choosing a separate model after viewing each confirmation fold

fresh_confirmation_freeze.minimum: 48 new counterfactual families per component with two primary variants per family; 96 effect groups per component and 384 total
fresh_confirmation_freeze.independent_unit: counterfactual family, with user/dialogue binding nested inside family

formal_head_gates.semantic_selection_value: must beat the frozen transparent rule on at least one predeclared selection metric without worse primary MSE
formal_head_gates.support: nonconstant targets and predictions with at least 12 independent families

fresh_confirmation_freeze.failed_head_action: fail closed; no external learned arm for that head

baseline_and_external_boundary.baseline_contract: v5_3_baseline_matrix_v1.json remains authoritative except the learned arm is named for the new release
baseline_and_external_boundary.external_execution: ESConv, EvoEmo response, and ES-MemEval remain blocked until a deployable learned head set and joint action projection are frozen

guarantee_boundary: This design cannot guarantee a favorable scientific outcome. It guarantees that semantic observability and effect separability are demonstrated before formal PM training, so a later head failure can validly be attributed to the PM rather than obviously unlearnable training data.
